canonical_name: zChaff (Princeton, 2001-2007) -- the Chaff CDCL SAT solver: VSIDS and two-watched-literals, the RIVAL MiniSat displaced
lineage: SAT lineage, the LOSING COMPETITOR: Chaff (Moskewicz, Madigan, Zhao, Zhang, Malik, DAC 2001) introduced the VSIDS decision heuristic and two-literal watching that every later CDCL solver uses; zChaff won SAT 2002. MiniSat (Een & Sorensson 2003) reimplemented the same ideas in a fraction of the code with better restarts/learnt-clause management and took the field; zChaff's last release is 2007.3.12 and it has not been developed since. Preserved from Princeton's page.

license.status: Princeton's zChaff licence: free for non-commercial research use (see the LICENSE/README in the zip); recorded, not asserted

compiler_or_interpreter: g++ 12 (docker bookworm) or gcc:4.9 if modern C++ rejects it (recorded)
entry_points: zchaff <cnf> [timeout]; zverify_df (proof checker); SAT_C.h library API

example.input: the same small SAT/UNSAT CNFs the vault used for picosat and minisat
example.output: RESULT: SAT / UNSAT (ORACLE: agreement with minisat-2.2.0 and picosat-965 on the same files)

upstream_docs: Moskewicz, Madigan, Zhao, Zhang, Malik, Chaff: Engineering an Efficient SAT Solver, DAC 2001
Zhang & Malik, The Quest for Efficient Boolean Satisfiability Solvers, CAV 2002

human_capability_summary.built_to: decide propositional satisfiability on industrial instances (verification, EDA) by conflict-driven learning with cheap propagation and a decaying activity heuristic
human_capability_summary.pressure: instance sizes from hardware verification; the SAT competitions; then a smaller, faster rival
human_capability_summary.success_means: correct SAT/UNSAT with a checkable proof; the human record: MiniSat's design beat it on speed and simplicity

human_environmental_pressure: combinatorial explosion, competition (SAT races), code complexity
human_failure_condition: a wrong UNSAT (hence zverify_df); or being out-competed
behavioral_entry_point: run zchaff, minisat-2.2.0 and picosat-965 on one harder CNF and record decisions/conflicts/time -- the lineage's selection pressure made measurable

lineage_relations.note: MiniSat (2003) reimplemented Chaff's ideas and displaced it

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run zchaff-2007
